args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks after the deploy of v2.3.1 across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 0.18. Mitigation: rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified successful — all three regions now running v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate down to 0.002. Follow-up: investigate the regression in v2.3.1 before any re-deploy.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions taken:

1. **Diagnosed:** checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back:** Reverted all regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production.
3. **Verified:** Service is now healthy across all regions with an error rate of 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident:** Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the failure, the rollback, and the verification results. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Recommend a follow-up investigation into the v2.3.1 regression before attempting any re-deploy.
